episode_title: Episode 2 - Should I Invest In Knowledge Or Products First?
question: Should you invest in product materials or marketing knowledge first when launching a product?
transcript_excerpt: You should definitely invest in your materials first before advertising. You need to know what your product looks like and feels like by ordering samples before doing anything else, because you need to have confidence in your product to sell it effectively. Once you confirm your sample and are ready to sell, then you invest in knowledge on marketing to understand your core audience and target customers.

episode_title: Episode 2 - Should I Invest In Knowledge Or Products First?
question: What is Jiffy Shirts and why is it recommended for ordering blank apparel?
transcript_excerpt: Jiffy Shirts (JiffyShirts.com) is a website that sells blank apparel of all brands without order minimums, so you can order one or two shirts. They carry hoodies, sweats, joggers, and brands like Gildan, Bella Canvas, Hanes, and Fruit of the Loom. It is recommended as a good starting point for beginners who don't have much to work with or don't want to do too much too fast.

episode_title: Episode 2 - Should I Invest In Knowledge Or Products First?
question: What is a resale certificate and why do you need one for wholesale blank purchases?
transcript_excerpt: A resale certificate is a document you file within your county, city, and state that permits you to buy wholesale and resell what you're buying within your estate. Many places won't even sell to you without a resale certificate. In Florida, you can apply for one online and if approved they send it to you in the mail. Once you have it, you can apply for wholesale accounts with companies like Bella Canvas.

episode_title: Episode 2 - Should I Invest In Knowledge Or Products First?
question: Why does Bella Canvas material quality differ from standard Gildan t-shirts?
transcript_excerpt: Bella Canvas uses 100 percent heirloom cotton that is combed and ring spun, making it really soft, whereas Gildan tees are 100 percent cotton that is not combed or ring spun. You can tell a total quality difference between them. Additionally, Gildan tees shrink because they're 100 percent cotton, so customers should hang dry items instead of using the dryer to avoid losing inches.

episode_title: Episode 2 - Should I Invest In Knowledge Or Products First?
question: How much does a sample cost from a manufacturer for custom cut and sew products?
transcript_excerpt: Samples from a manufacturer that cuts and sews an item from raw materials typically run anywhere between 150 to 300 dollars for one item. Most manufacturers will deduct the sample price from your bulk order after you verify the price, so it is not a complete waste of money but rather an investment in testing the product before selling to the public.

episode_title: Episode 2 - Should I Invest In Knowledge Or Products First?
question: What monthly income and expense structure should you establish before investing in a business?
transcript_excerpt: At an $11 per hour job working 40 hours per week, you take home approximately 650 dollars every two weeks or about 1,300 dollars per month after taxes. If your monthly expenses for rent, utilities, food, and transportation total $1,000, you would have $300 left. You should not invest all $300 into your business; instead, save $150-$250 per paycheck until you reach a startup amount of $1,000 to $3,000-$500 before starting, depending on your comfort level.
